text:
elaine: Hey team — I've addressed the review comments on PR #3421, split the large refactor into a small migration commit + a follow-up, added unit tests and a smoke script. PTAL when you have a sec: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/3421 :eyes:
jack: Skimming now. Did you change any public API surfaces? Need a changelog entry if so.
elaine: No breaking API changes — only internal refactor. I added a short changelog line in docs/CHANGELOG.md and kept public function signatures stable. Smoke script lives at infra/smoke/run_kvcache_smoke.sh.
sam: CI was flaky on macOS last time for similar flows — did you add an e2e to catch that?
elaine: Added an integration test for the fallback path (tests/integration/fallback_test.py) and a tiny retry wrapper. CI is green locally for me.
ci-bot: CI passed — all checks green (build #789).
jack: Looks good from my side. One nit about a comment but non-blocking. Can you rebase on main?
elaine: Rebased and pushed. Thanks — @maria can you do a quick perf smoke? I'd like to hit the canary window next Tue 10:00 PT if we get 2 approvals.
maria: I can take perf smoke Tuesday morning. PTAL at the unit test change — LGTM.
sam: +1 from me as well. Left a tiny log-level nit.
elaine: Addressed the log-level nit and squashed the tiny style fix. PTAL for merge. If we have two approvals I'll schedule the canary Monday evening or Tue morning depending on ops.
jack: Approving now. :thumbsup:
maria: Approved. I'll run the perf smoke and post results to this thread.
elaine: Thanks all — tagging the canary ops doc: https://intra.redwood/canary-ops. I'll kick the rollout once perf smoke is green.
